all_calls.name: Bash
all_calls.arg:
python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/batch-484f1c11bbd6f0f5bb87-contextual-000/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-final-full.json'))
p=d['payload']
ts=p['translation_snapshot']; bc=p['bounded_context']; keys=p['ordered_revision_keys']
for i,k in enumerate(keys):
    t=ts[i]; c=bc[i]
    assert t['revision_key']==k==c['revision_key']
    head,_,rest=c['context'].partition('\n')
    f=json.loads(rest.split('source_facts_v1:',1)[1])['fact']
    print('=== %d %s'%(i,k[:10]))
    print('PATH:',head)
    print('SRC:',json.dumps(t['source'],ensure_ascii=False))
    print('TGT:',json.dumps(t.get('target'),ensure_ascii=False))
    print('CTX:',json.dumps(t.get('context'),ensure_ascii=False))
    print('term:',json.dumps(f['terminology'],ensure_ascii=False))
    print('ph:',f['placeholders'],f['placeholders_in_target'],f['placeholder_order_matches'],f['evidence_status'])
    for a in f['anchors']:
        print(' ANCHOR',a['public_source_path'],a['matching_lines'])
        for s in a['snippet']:
            print('   ','*' if s['is_match'] else ' ',s['line'],s['text'])
"
